en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a waterfall in a wooded, hilly landscape in winter or early spring (leafless trees). In the foreground there is a wooden or metal conduit or aqueduct supported by posts, with a small bridge structure. The waterfall drops from a rocky height amid trees. Printed French captions at the top identify the location as a cascade near Granges, in the environs of Saint-Nectaire, and a small credit line to the publisher appears at the bottom right.
